title: Tesla travels to Europe to persuade Hertz he was wrong

tellings.quote: he was at least from what I've read he actually traveled uh to Europe

plain: Nikola Tesla once travelled to Europe to persuade the physicist Heinrich Hertz that Hertz was wrong, at some point between the late 1880s and the end of the century. A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell tells Michels this, saying it comes "from what I've read" but naming no source. The point is that Tesla held a different view of physics, one that McConnell suggests is still not fully understood.
